name: Unscreen
summary: Unscreen allows you to remove video backgrounds automatically without a green screen. Ideal for social content, memes, and remote presentations.
description:
Unscreen allows you to remove video backgrounds automatically without a green screen. Ideal for social content, memes, and remote presentations.

Automatic background removal: Instantly removes video backgrounds without needing a green screen or manual masking. Supports GIF, MOV, MP4: Works with multiple video and animation formats for broad compatibility. Batch upload: Process many videos at once for efficient content creation. Custom backgrounds: Replace backgrounds with images, colors, or other videos to suit your project.

pricing.label: Freemium

howToUse.title: Visit the Unscreen website.
howToUse.description: Visit the Unscreen website. You can use it online without registration for smaller files, or sign up for batch and advanced features.

howToUse.title: Click 'Upload Clip' and select your video or GIF.
howToUse.description: Click 'Upload Clip' and select your video or GIF. Supported formats include MP4, MOV, and GIF.

howToUse.title: Let Unscreen process the video.
howToUse.description: Let Unscreen process the video. The background will be removed automatically, no green screen required.

howToUse.title: Add a new background: choose a solid color, upload an image, or select a video background...
howToUse.description: Add a new background: choose a solid color, upload an image, or select a video background for your subject.

howToUse.title: Preview the output and download your video or GIF with the new background.
howToUse.description: Preview the output and download your video or GIF with the new background. Free version may include a watermark.

howToUse.description: If you need to process many videos, sign up for a paid plan and use Unscreen Pro for batch uploads and higher resolution output.
